text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just like a veteran actor waiting in the 
wings, Cesario quietly concentrated.
choice_data_list:
Looks like your fighting spirit is fully 
dialed in.

Looks like your fighting spirit is fully 
dialed in.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
...Yes. All that's left now is to make 
sure I seize victory in the race right 
before me.
choice_data_list:
You're the star today, so go out there and 
run with all you've got!

You are the star today, so go out there 
and run with all you've got!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much. Not just for the 
present, but also to serve as a beacon for 
my future students...

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
With a run that captivates the hearts of 
all who watch, I shall seize glory.
choice_data_list: A tremendous ovation surely awaits you.
A tremendous ovation surely awaits you.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Yes... It will surely echo throughout the 
entire racecourse.
